svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: ML platform on AWS
svg.desc: ML platform on AWS. 11 components in 3 groups. Connections: Raw data lake to Feature pipeline; Feature pipeline to Feature Store; Feature Store to Train; Train to Evaluate; Evaluate to Model Registry; Model Registry to Batch transform; Model Registry to Real-time endpoint; Batch transform to Predictions; Real-time endpoint to Drift alarm (captured traffic); Training pipeline to Retraining rule (StartExecution); Retraining rule to Drift alarm.

text.tspan: Amazon SageMaker AI and AWS Step Functions train and serve models; drift alarms retrain them
